title: Harness-governed pure-Git pending-branch auto-merge and verified release-candidate promotion
goal: Complete the Susi-native Git-storage integration and release workflow governed by susi-harness and daemon.harness: automatic pending development-branch discovery and 3-way object-store reconciliation into unqualified development main (skipping retired branches, active dirty/claimed worktrees, secret files, and host-created web commits while isolating merge conflicts), strictly separated from distillation-receipt-verified release candidate promotion on local release/<name> and immutable refs/tags/susi-distill/<name> storage snapshots.
